player_prompt.intro:
Kuwa kaa'ana kuwa Minesweeper.
Manufar kuwa kaa'ana ka cikinna wata kuwa ba mine.
Don kuwa yi move, kawai kaa'ana row da column coordinates ka kona reveal da format:
- `[row col]`: Reveal cell din da specified row da column.
Misali:
- `[3 2]` don reveal cell din Row 3, Column 2.
- `[5 6]` don reveal cell din Row 5, Column 6.
A kan kuwa first move, ka kona reveal wuri da cell ka kona choose don ensure safe start.
Current board layout din anan nuna below. Cells din ba revealed din anan represented da dot ('.'), revealed numbers din nuna count din adjacent mines.
Kuwa mindful ba choose already revealed cells.
Ga current board layout din:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nyiye jawawu nyibe kәla coordinatewa kalkal suro square bracketsben gәnyi.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Kәla layi-a column-aye dә kalkallo ba.
invalid_move.already_revealed: Kamaye kashara ({row}, {col}) kamaye kawuwa a kashara.

outcome.win: Congratulations! Nyiye kənasarro minesweeper board dәga koltǝgǝna.
